description: Create a Gantt chart from a task list — no account or API key needed. YOU author the plan: list the tasks in execution order with realistic working-day durations and dependencies (0-based positions of earlier tasks; use { task, type, lag } for start-to-start/finish-to-finish links or lag). Milestones have duration 0. Group tasks into top-level phases for a structured plan/WBS: the phase task gets isPhase: true, its tasks get parent = the position of the phase. LoopGantt schedules it with its critical-path engine and returns a picture of the chart, the dates, the critical path and a link where the user can view, export (PNG/PDF) and save the chart. Always show the user the link.

dependencies.description: Predecessors: positions (0-based) of EARLIER tasks in this list, or objects { task, type: FS|SS|FF|SF, lag } for typed links / lag in days

duration.description: Working days (default 1). 0 makes the task a milestone.

isMilestone.description: Milestone (zero duration, drawn as a diamond)

isPhase.description: Top-level phase (a group). Tasks join it with parent = this position. Phases take no dependencies and no parent; their dates become the envelope of their tasks.

parent.description: Position (0-based) of an EARLIER task with isPhase=true that this task belongs to

workDays.description: Working weekdays as ISO numbers 1 (Mon) … 7 (Sun). Default Mon–Fri.

name: create_gantt
